name: A_REEL_RENDER_COMPOSED
description: Render a ComposedPlan (schema_version 'compose-p2') to MP4 via cosmic-video render-composed-plan. Distinct from A_REEL_RENDER (which renders a P1 reel-plan).

plan_path.description: Absolute path to the ComposedPlan JSON (schema_version 'compose-p2')

out.description: Absolute path for the rendered MP4 output

error.description: Present iff status === 'fail'; pipelineError code (e.g. RENDER_FFMPEG_FAILED, RENDER_PLAN_SCHEMA_MISMATCH)

notes: Exit codes from cosmic-video render-composed-plan: 0 on success; 2 on validated/expected failure (RENDER_PLAN_FILE_NOT_FOUND, RENDER_PLAN_PARSE_FAILED, RENDER_PLAN_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, RENDER_FFMPEG_FAILED, PROJECT_ROOT_UNRESOLVED); 1 on UNHANDLED (no parseable last-line JSON — A_REEL_RENDER_COMPOSED must NOT attempt to parse stdout on exit 1). COSMIC_PROJECT_ROOT (P3 CR-6/CR-8): when set by the parent, the CLI auto-resolves projectRoot and defaults --out to <projectRoot>/media/reels/<basename>.mp4 if the caller omits it; inherited from parent env via Bun.spawn — no Input field required.
